name: clickhouse_tool
description: Read-only SQL access to the airkit ClickHouse database (alerts, incidents, process_events, network_events, auth_events, file_events, raw_events). Enforces a hard SELECT-only guard — no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL is possible even if requested, since this tool exists for investigation, not remediation.

tools.name: query_clickhouse_logs
tools.description: Execute a read-only SQL query against airkit ClickHouse tables. Query must be a single SELECT statement.

sql_query.description: A single SELECT statement against airkit.* tables. Multi-statement queries and any non-SELECT statement are rejected.

max_rows.description: Hard cap on rows returned, to avoid flooding the agent's context with an unbounded result set.

tools.name: get_host_telemetry
tools.description: Convenience wrapper: returns all event classes (process, network, auth, file, alerts) for a given hostname within a time window, pre-joined and time-ordered. This is the most common first query in triage, so it's exposed as its own tool rather than requiring the agent to hand-write a UNION query every time.

tools.name: correlate_ip_pcap
tools.description: Convenience wrapper: returns all network_events involving a given source IP (as src or dst) within a time window.
